mirror.name: Kaggle Bhagavad Gita dataset
mirror.note: The mirror is not treated as an independent textual witness; its stated license conflicts with the license file contained in its archive.

alignment.policy: For the 27 default-layout fields, chapter colophons and the alternate Chapter 13 opening are preserved as paratext, and Chapter 13 source units 2–35 align to canonical verses 1–34. The two Prabhupada fields omit colophons: Chapter 13 uses the same source-minus-one mapping, while Chapter 1 source 1.36 covers canonical 1.36–1.37 and later source units shift forward by one canonical verse.
